name: Liaison
source:
Kusanagi Daisakusa came to Tokyo to attend art university with a dream of becoming a painter, but he clearly lacked talent. One day he meets two women in jewelry store and that casual encounter greatly influenced his life and his upcoming biggest masterpiece.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
草薙大作为进入美术大学来到东京，梦想成为画家，却显然缺乏才华。某天，他在一家珠宝店遇见两名女性。这场偶然邂逅深刻影响了他的人生，以及即将完成的最伟大杰作。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
